script_text: Aries, the cosmos is about to test your patience and reward your fire. Early week, the Sun in Sagittarius trines Saturn in your 1st House, so Thursday and Friday favor disciplined career moves and a serious money talk in your 8th House, where Mercury in Scorpio sharpens negotiation. Avoid rushing a quick contract Monday, when Mercury squares Jupiter in Leo and overpromises inflate your 5th House romance. Midweek, Mars in Libra activates your 7th House of partnership, turning flirtation into a real commitment conversation. Late week, Venus in Sagittarius trines Saturn, stabilizing love and travel plans; your weekend looks grounded but affectionate. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Saturn and supports a relationship or financial agreement. Monday is your caution day because Mercury squares Jupiter and exaggerates personal risk. Use your fire to ask for exactly what you want. Follow for daily updates.
